## Safety Checklist

- [ ] No secrets, tokens, stream keys, webhook payloads, or private user data are committed.
- [ ] User-facing errors are safe and actionable.
- [ ] Protected resources are checked server-side.
- [ ] API input and output are validated with Zod where applicable.
- [ ] Media/export/download/streaming changes are ownership-safe where applicable.
- [ ] Documentation is updated for behavior, setup, or API changes.
